$comment: Hand-made decisions the name rules cannot derive. Read by scripts/mapping.mjs; never written by it. Keyed by consumer entry id. `token` overrides the derived target (null means deliberately unmapped), `status` overrides the derived status, `reason` and `recommendation` are prose for the report. check:consumers fails on any entry here that no longer matches a consumer entry, so this file cannot go quietly stale.

colorRoles.border.focused.reason: Core.Border.Focused and Extension.Border.Focused both exist; the app's border.focused is the generic one, so it takes the Core token

colorRoles.background.dataVisPrimary.reason: the app's six dataVis roles are all brown[100] in the base theme and only diverge under a feature theme; the tokens carry a real Brown ramp
colorRoles.background.dataVisPrimary.recommendation: adopt the token — the app value is a placeholder, not a considered colour

colorRoles.background.dataVisSecondary.reason: placeholder in the app's base theme (all six dataVis roles share one value)

colorRoles.background.dataVisTertiary.reason: placeholder in the app's base theme (all six dataVis roles share one value)

colorRoles.background.dataVisQuaternary.reason: placeholder in the app's base theme (all six dataVis roles share one value)

colorRoles.background.dataVisQuinary.reason: placeholder in the app's base theme (all six dataVis roles share one value)

colorRoles.background.dataVisSenary.reason: the token ramp stops at Quinary; the app has a sixth role whose base value is the same placeholder as the other five
colorRoles.background.dataVisSenary.recommendation: drop the role rather than add a primitive — nothing distinguishes it today

colors.yellow.50.reason: #FDF0C5 vs Yellow.50 #FAEFC5 — two digits transposed, not a design difference

colorRoles.content.warningLight.recommendation: realign to the token value; fixing colors.yellow.50 fixes this row too

colorRoles.border.selected.reason: app uses brown[700] #5B3935, the token uses Brown.800 #47201C — one step apart, so this is a real divergence rather than a slip
colorRoles.border.selected.recommendation: realign to the token, but get design to confirm the darker border is intended

colorRoles.background.navbar.reason: no Base token names a navbar; the app's value is brown[50], identical to background.primary
colorRoles.background.navbar.recommendation: realign to Core.Background.Primary rather than add a primitive — the role carries no distinct value

colorRoles.content.onColor.reason: deprecated in the app, but still live in Button/constants/colors.ts
colorRoles.content.onColor.recommendation: drop — but migrate the four Button call sites to content.onColorLight first

ColorRolesHelper::Background::LIGHT_NEGA.recommendation: adopt the token — the only pre-rebrand constant whose value survived the rebrand unchanged (#FFC3B6 = Red.100)

ColorRolesHelper::Border::ACCENT.reason: tokens split accent into AccentLight/Mid/Dark, so there is no Border.Accent to map to
ColorRolesHelper::Border::ACCENT.recommendation: 1 live call site — pick a specific Extension.Border.Accent{Light,Mid,Dark} with design, or delete alongside the other pre-rebrand constants

ColorRolesHelper::Background::INVERSE_TR.reason: value is 'FFFFFF33' — no leading '#', 8 digits. Zero references.
ColorRolesHelper::Background::INVERSE_TR.recommendation: delete. Also the concrete case COREEXP-324 (alpha / 8-digit hex) exists for.
